description.en: One goal in the owner's signed-in Chrome on the browser machine through jev-ultrafast, then the page it ends on: its address, a status, the number of actions and the visible text. Lane Pilot starts it from lane_pilot_helpers (action browser); the action browser.goal can be used in any graph.
description.ru: Одна цель в браузере владельца (с его входами) на браузерной машине через jev-ultrafast и страница, на которой всё закончилось: адрес, статус, число действий и видимый текст. Запускается инструментом lane_pilot_helpers (action browser); действие browser.goal можно ставить в любой граф.

not_for: anything a person asks in a chat: the PM starts it with lane_pilot_helpers (action browser)

goal.note: what to reach or read, in words

changes.note: true when the goal changes, submits, deletes, pays or publishes anything; then authorized must be true

title.en: Do the goal in the browser

nodes.rule: code: one host call to the browser machine (browser_qa.host_id); read-only unless changes and authorized are both true; a goal that changes something is never repeated after a reload
